desc.zh: 从重复扫描出发，推导单调双端队列如何在线维护每个窗口的最大值。
desc.en: Start from repeated scans and derive a monotonic deque that maintains every window maximum online.

concepts.name: Expired index
concepts.description: Remove indices that have fallen left of the current window.

concepts.name: Monotonic decreasing deque
concepts.description: Keep only candidates whose values decrease from front to back.

concepts.name: Amortized linear time
concepts.description: Each index enters and leaves the deque at most once.
